title: Algorithm: IoT Telemetry Sensor Accumulator
subtitle: Processing Streaming Data Batches
description: Aggregate hardware telemetry readings across 2 interactive stages!
starter_code:
readings = [22.5, 24.0, 23.5]
total = 0.0
# Stage 1: Loop and accumulate total

challenges.title: Stage 1: Sum Telemetry Readings
challenges.description: Loop over <hlt>readings</hlt> and accumulate into <hlt>total</hlt>. Print <hlt>total</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
readings = [22.5, 24.0, 23.5]
total = 0.0
# Stage 1: Accumulate total
for val in readings:
    total = total + val
print(total)

challenges.title: Stage 2: Calculate Average Reading
challenges.description: Compute mean average: <hlt>avg = total / len(readings)</hlt> and print <hlt>round(avg, 2)</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
readings = [22.5, 24.0, 23.5]
total = 0.0
for val in readings:
    total = total + val
# Stage 2: Compute average
avg = total / len(readings)
print(round(avg, 2))
